saberes.saber: Expand social interaction, affectivity, expression of feelings and empathy. Know how to deal with your emotions

kids: Demonstrate empathy for others by realizing that people have different feelings, needs and ways of thinking and acting.
Know and express your feelings and emotions, naming them.
Demonstrate care for the environment - animals and plants.
Demonstrate attitudes of care and solidarity in the interaction with children and adults and the environment – animals and plants, flora and fauna.
Understand the importance of environmental preservation and care for the environment.
Coexist harmoniously with children and educators demonstrating attitudes of participation, cooperation, decision making and conflict resolution
Manifest interest and respect for different cultures, ways of life and social rules.

saberes.saber: Build a positive self-image, gain self-confidence, independence and autonomy.

kids: Act independently, with confidence in your abilities, recognizing your achievements and limitations.
Manifest a positive image of oneself and confidence in one's capacity to face difficulties and challenges.
Develop notions of care with personal health and the community in general.
Identify risk situations in the environment and develop a notion of physical integrity.
Demonstrate appreciation for the characteristics of your body and respect the characteristics of others (children and adults).
Communicate your ideas and feelings to diverse people and groups. Argue and raise hypotheses.
Participate actively, creatively and critically in the preparation of agreements, routine actions and other school activities.
Take independent care of your belongings and collective belongings.
Respect rules of social interaction in interactions and games, relating in a cooperative and solidary manner

saberes.saber: Know and respect ethnic, cultural, gender differences and disabilities. Know and respect the different social roles and functions existing in your group of relations and society. Develop the construction of ethical, moral and citizenship values

kids: Relate your school learning with your personal and social experiences and vice versa

saberes.saber: Know, develop, express and expand, progressively, the possibilities of your body.

kids: Gradually understand the functioning of one's own body.
Create with the body diversified forms of expression of feelings, sensations and emotions, both in daily situations and in play, dance, theater and music.
Experience, create and perform rhythmic movements individually and in groups
Understand the use of one's own body in play and games, listening and retelling stories, artistic activities, among other possibilities.
Create movements, gestures, looks and mimes in play, games and artistic activities such as dance, theater and music.
Utilize the movements of grasping, fitting and throwing, expanding your possibilities of handling different materials and objects.
Explore and produce the sounds of one's own body and environmental sounds, creating rhythmic situations.
Develop and expand the possibilities of movement, such as strength, resistance, speed and flexibility through play.
Raise hypotheses and express questions about body development.

saberes.saber: Develop and express sensitivity, imagination, creativity, ideas, sensations and feelings through Libras (Brazilian Sign Language) and facial and bodily expressions and diverse materials

kids: Create and sign in Libras about your productions assigning meaning to them
Use drawing, painting, modeling and other artistic expressions to represent, express oneself and communicate in Libras
Interact and assign meaning to the utility of different daily technologies (scissors, mouse, bag, pen, videoconferencing on different supports and others)
Participate in dances, play and child-child and child-adult interaction activity.
Appreciate and perform bodily movements from diverse types of dance.
Create and feel the vibration of musical instruments
Observe, know and explore different visual works.

saberes.saber: Develop and express sensitivity, imagination, creativity, ideas, sensations and feelings through voice, body and various materials.

kids: Create and dialogue about your productions assigning meaning to them
Explore and understand the diversity, characteristics and properties of objects and materials.
Use different materials, supports and procedures to record, exploring colors, textures, surfaces, planes, shapes and volumes.
Draw freely on different supports (including digital supports) and spaces using various materials and techniques.
Experiment in your productions with constituent elements of visual language: point, line, shape, color, volume, contrast, light, space and transformed texture.
Create two-dimensional and three-dimensional productions using varied materials with possibilities of manipulation.
Use drawing, painting, modeling and other artistic expressions to represent, express oneself and communicate.
Interact and assign meaning to the utility of different daily technologies (scissors, mouse, radio, bag, pen, telephone and others).
Follow rhythms and produce sound sequences.
Create and use sounds produced by one's own body, materials, objects and musical instruments in various environments and record through audio and/or video
Manipulate technological devices that produce sounds (radio, recorder, headphones).
Recognize your own voice, interacting and producing audios.
Reproduce and create different sounds.
Listen to and appreciate different musical genres.
Distinguish sounds of nature, the environment and people.
Appreciate and produce music with different rhythms and sounds.
Participate in dances, sung games, 'cirandas' in child-child and child-adult interaction
Appreciate and perform body movements from various types of dance and musical rhythm.

saberes.saber: Enjoy/appreciate different forms of artistic expression (theater, cinema, literature, music, television, 'ciranda', photography, 'sarau', dance, sculpture, dubbing, media).

kids: Experience different forms of artistic expression
Interact with your productions and those of others.
Observe, know and explore different visual and sound works.
Understand and appreciate the diversity of artistic production.
Appreciate images of the arts in different supports, such as art books, magazines, visits to exhibitions, contact with artists, films, media, among others.

Appreciate and identify the artistic expressions of different social groups (examples: children's, indigenous, popular art, from different eras, works of art and their respective artists, daily images, photographs, play with light and shadow, also using technologies)
Photograph from your point of view people and places, consider focus and distance
Perceive the possibilities of intervening in photographed images.

saberes.saber: Express your needs, desires, feelings and ideas through diverse languages, participating in communicative situations.

kids: Create different sounds and recognize rhymes and tongue-twisters in wheel songs and poetic texts
Differentiate writing from illustrations in stories and other texts, and follow, with orientation from educators and/or children, the direction of reading (top to bottom, left to right).
Invent variations of intonation and gestures when listening to stories and singing.
Participate in situations of listening to texts in different textual genres (poems, fables, short stories, recipes, comics, advertisements etc.).
Dialogue with children and adults, expressing your desires, needs, feelings and opinions, participating in situations that involve the need to explain and argue your ideas
Invent sung games, poems and songs, creating rhymes, tongue-twisters and rhythms etc.
Describe and create scenarios, characters and main events of daily facts and narrated stories.

saberes.saber: Experience spontaneity, imagination, creation and expression, expanding the symbolic function.

kids: Gradually expand the production of individual and collective texts, with different functions, having the educator as scribe
Write spontaneously individually and collectively, using the knowledge available at the moment about written language
Know and select different carriers and textual genres (starting from your repertoire on these texts, such as recovery by memory, by reading illustrations etc.).
Experience situations involving letters and numbers.
Participate in different situations of use of orality.
Create symbols from the constructed repertoire.
Create theatrical games to develop expressiveness and expand imagination.
Conduct research and systematize through graphic records (drawings and spontaneous writing) characteristics of different observed objects, animals and landscapes
Differentiate your own name among several and write it with or without support.
Create and express yourself through tracing and spontaneous writing.
Use reading as a source of pleasure and entertainment.
Expand hypotheses about textual genres conveyed in known carriers.
Write spontaneously individually and collectively, using the knowledge available at the moment about written language
Know and select different carriers and textual genres (starting from your repertoire on these texts, such as recovery by memory, by reading illustrations etc.)
Experience situations involving letters and numbers.

qsn.eixo: Vision, Imagination, Thought, Communication and Signaling in Libras

saberes.saber: Express your needs, desires, feelings and ideas through diverse languages, participating in communicative situations.

kids: Play, create, imagine, build toys and games daily, spontaneously, collectively, developing and expanding repertoire, vocabulary and communication
Identify yourself as deaf and others as deaf and hearing.
Observe, imitate and create variations of gesturality when retelling stories in Libras.
Participate in situations of reading texts in different textual genres in Sign Language (poems, fables, stories, recipes, comics, advertisements etc.).
Use Libras to play, communicate and express desires, needs, opinions, ideas, preferences and feelings and report your experiences, gradually expanding the repertoire and vocabulary.
Invent games, gestures, movements, rhymes and finger-twisters.
Describe and create scenarios, characters and main events of daily facts and stories in Sign Languages
Observe, identify and use facial and bodily expressions, establishing visual contact
Perceive and understand the importance of visual contact for the communication of the deaf person and follow with the eyes the movement of the signer's hand.
Observe and gradually explore the elements of visual perception and discrimination, through images.
Explore the elements of visual perception and discrimination in the identification of sign language traits, gradually expanding improvement strategies.

qsn.eixo: Spaces, Times, Quantities, Relations and Transformations

saberes.saber: Expand world knowledge and develop attitudes of respect and responsibility over it and its elements

kids: Build new inquiries and hypotheses, from your explorations.
Observe, interact and describe phenomena and elements of nature (sunlight, wind, rain, water, air, soil etc.).
Search and select sources of information (books, magazines, maps, interviews, internet search tools) that help answer questions about the natural world and nature conservation
Appreciate and become familiar with customs, habits, practices and stories of the local culture and other cultures
Explore cause and effect relationships in interaction with the physical world (construction and observation of experiments etc.).
Express yourself through diverse languages about your observations, doubts and hypotheses
Identify, name and use the social function of daily objects, besides appropriating that function
Handle and explore scrap materials and technological devices (keyboard, mouse, telephone, remote control etc.).
Experiment with interactions with technological resources during play
Report in games or daily occasions facts about your life history and daily situations, as well as the history of your family and community.

Research and reflect on the diversities of human, animal and vegetable characteristics of the material and technological world, through the examination of various themes (Food, Biodiversity, Sustainability, Means of communication, Means of transport, among others)
Recognize the school and the neighborhood – locating oneself in the urban space.

saberes.saber: Develop notions of measurements and quantities, logical reasoning, mathematical language, spatial and temporal relations and use them in daily life.

kids: Use, with the support of adults, time marking instruments (calendars, clocks, routines etc.)
Represent through various languages two-dimensional and three-dimensional objects of objects.
Classify objects according to their similarities and differences, also using technologies as a resource.
Traverse and narrate routes observing reference points in your path
Observe, explore and handle conventional and non-conventional measurements, recording them through multiple languages (drawing, recording by numbers or spontaneous writing), in different supports
Create strategies to deal with and resolve daily problem situations.
Perceive and use numerical sequences in various contexts (games and songs that include forms of counting)
Know and use numbers with distinct social functions.
Relate through playful activities numbers and their respective quantities.
Express measurements (weight, height etc.), building basic graphs.
